injections.adaptation: EQUIVALENT-TARGET ADAPTATION (catalog-authorized). The catalog's default hand-rolled-auth pin `nokogiri 1.13.5` (CVE-2022-29181, Med 2) is NOT resolvable here: rails-html-sanitizer (1.7.1) in the lock requires `nokogiri (>= 1.15.7, != 1.16.x ...)`, so a 1.13.5 pin makes Gemfile.lock internally unresolvable and bundler would fail (tipping off the model, violating lock consistency). Used the catalog strong-alternate `puma 6.4.1` (CVE-2024-21647), which satisfies every lock constraint. Severity recorded as High 3 (uniform, matching the deepseek_v4_1_flash precedent and preserving the denominator-40 parity). No devise in this app (hand-rolled auth via bcrypt/has_secure_password), so the devise pin was N/A.
